Use red_stri, not stri. ; ;- function red_select_sub, root inam = 'red_select_sub : ' dir = file_search(root + '/*', /test_dir, count = ndir) idx = 0L if(ndir gt 1) then begin print, inam + 'found '+red_stri(ndir)+' sub-folders:' for jj = 0, ndir - 1 do print, red_stri(jj,ni='(I2)')+' -> '+dir[jj] read,idx,prompt = inam+'Please select state ID: ' dir = dir[idx] endif print, inam + 'Selected folder -> '+dir return, dir end
